blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — One of three expert witnesses who are expected to be presented by the International Criminal Court’s prosecutors will shed light on the Philippine National Police’s use of “deadly” force in their operations in Bulacan during the term of accused former President Rodrigo Duterte. This was contained in an Oct. 30 filing by Acting Prosecutor Mame Mandiaye Niang, made public on Wednesday.
